method.type: independent exact-engine grid probe; not browser QA
method.engine: Delivered js/config.js + js/motor.js + delivered 12 field files executed in Node
method.click_sampling: 12 px regular grid over initial camera; no UI occluders except motor horizon
method.caveat: An accepted blind point is not automatically a scientifically false result. This probe measures selectivity/brute-force resistance of the current recognition rule, complementing C18 coverage.

conclusion: R02 improves R01 substantially, but fixed min radius 88 px remains disproportionately permissive on narrow viewports. Coverage/intention QA should be complemented with blind-click/specificity QA.
